name: portrait-studio-for-chatgpt
description: A local, deterministic JPEG and PNG portrait editor with optional ChatGPT reference analysis.

interface.longDescription: Preview deterministic color adjustments, crop, use a manual clone brush, and export a full-resolution lossless PNG. Image editing stays in the app UI. ChatGPT sees a reference image only after you choose Ask ChatGPT.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Portrait Studio for ChatGPT to preview and export a portrait edit.
